propositions: Nothing alerts or warns when an expected Pass-2 verification block is absent from a code-review finding, despite verification_recorded being absent from all source, test, and documentation.
The verification_recorded signal must be scoped to LLM-tier findings excluding indeterminate/no-verification cases to avoid standing false alarms on routine runs with DET-tier detector findings.

verification blocks with {binary, severity_attributes} are already persisted by code_review.sidecar.build_payload via field-spread, not dropped; the audit confirmed 97.5% presence across 3,583 of 3,673 findings.

The 90 findings without verification blocks are legitimately unverified: 61 DET-tier/untiered findings that never enter Pass-2, and 29 LLM-tier indeterminate findings with reason=no-verification that pass3_decide correctly degraded.
A WARNING with the missing count must be emitted when verify_requests > 0 and at least one LLM-tier decided finding lacks a verification block, adding verification_recorded boolean to metrics dict.
